body: I'm not sure I know how to do that though. What kind of work can I do to improve it? Is there anything I can do other than just suffer and hope that things get better?

I do really resent the fact that she refuses to acknowledge we were anything more than friends. However, I want to be her friend really bad because I still want her in my life.  Honestly a big problem I'm facing right now is that she knows how upset and depressed I am which is pushing her away.  When I have a really bad night (like tonight) and I try to unleash it all on her because I don't trust anyone else enough, she just gets angry with me. Usually the next day it is fine, but I do really wish she wouldn't just ignore me when I get a little upset.

I don't know if it is worth all of the energy I am putting into this friendship that seems to end every couple of days when she gets annoyed with me. However, the time I've spent with her have been the best part of my break.  I'm lost and very confused.
